description: Round-six held-out synthetic meetings for the variant robustness eval, written blind to earlier rounds and to the Rust implementation. Settings are a dental practice rota, a podcast production, a school trip, a bike-repair co-op, a translation agency and a community radio station. They cover conditional and negated commitments, negated group decisions, spoken headings, supplier and product names that look like people or places, restricted prices, quantities restated mid-meeting, ownership corrections, date corrections within a sentence and by another speaker with a confirmation, multi-word dates, questions and ideas that are not tasks, completed statuses and reported speech.

segments.speaker: Wilhelmina
segments.text: Rota. We agreed to move the Saturday clinic to alternate weekends from October the ninth, but only if Cosima can find a second hygienist.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Rota: I'll cover the late shift on Thursday, no, Friday, unless the lab delivers the crowns early.

segments.speaker: Cosima
segments.text: Supplies. Our supplier, Halvorsen Dental, quoted 45 pounds a box for the gloves, or 38 pounds a box for orders of 20 boxes or more.

segments.speaker: Dag
segments.text: I'll order the new sterilizer from Halvorsen by the 26th, I mean the 28th.

segments.speaker: Wilhelmina
segments.text: Dag will book the X-ray engineer for the 12th.

segments.speaker: Dag
segments.text: Ravi already has the engineer's number, so Ravi should book it. Does anyone want to look at a second compressor? That's only a question, not a task.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Fine, I'll book the X-ray engineer.

segments.speaker: Cosima
segments.text: Not the 12th, the 19th. The engineer is on leave that week.

segments.speaker: Wilhelmina
segments.text: Fine, the 19th then.

segments.speaker: Cosima
segments.text: Rota. Ines, the new receptionist, told me the patient reminder texts are already fixed, and the hygiene audit was approved last week. We decided not to extend the opening hours this winter, and I won't change the lunch cover until Wilhelmina signs off the rota.

segments.speaker: Lorcan
segments.text: Episodes. We decided to publish the new season on the 14th of November, provided that the sponsor reads are recorded by then.

segments.speaker: Marisol
segments.text: Guests: I'll email the three guests about their interview slots by Tuesday, or rather Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Thaddeus
segments.text: Budget. Mixing costs 120 pounds an episode, or 90 pounds an episode if we book ten episodes in one go.

segments.speaker: Yevgenia
segments.text: Hosting. Dorrit from the hosting company told me the new feed was approved yesterday.

segments.speaker: Yevgenia
segments.text: I'll proofread the transcripts by the 10th, only if the audio files are in the shared folder.

segments.speaker: Marisol
segments.text: Lorcan will send the trailer to the network by the 12th.

segments.speaker: Thaddeus
segments.text: Sorry, their team is away that week, so make it the 19th.

segments.speaker: Lorcan
segments.text: Okay, the 19th works for me. And I won't pay the cover artist's invoice until the final artwork is approved.

segments.speaker: Yevgenia
segments.text: We agreed not to add a second weekly episode this season. Marisol said the guest booking spreadsheet is already done.

segments.speaker: Gwendolyn
segments.text: Trip planning. We decided to take the geography group to the Marlow Science Centre on the 22nd of October, as long as at least 40 permission slips come back.

segments.speaker: Osei
segments.text: Transport: we need 3 coaches for the pupils. Actually, make that 4, the sixth form added a class.

segments.speaker: Rosalind
segments.text: Costs. The trip is 12 pounds a pupil, or 8 pounds a pupil for pupils who get free school meals.

segments.speaker: Anselm
segments.text: I'll book the coaches by the 12th, or rather the 14th, once the headteacher signs the risk assessment.

segments.speaker: Gwendolyn
segments.text: Fitzroy from the Marlow Centre told me the workshop room is booked until noon.

segments.speaker: Osei
segments.text: I won't chase the parents for payment until Rosalind has sent the reminder letter.

segments.speaker: Rosalind
segments.text: I'll collect the permission slips from the office on Friday. Anselm, could you ask whether the museum cafe takes group bookings? That's only a question, not a task.

segments.speaker: Anselm
segments.text: The risk assessment draft is already done, and the parent helper list was approved on Monday.

segments.speaker: Gwendolyn
segments.text: We agreed not to run a second trip this term, and Osei told me the minibus is under repair.

segments.speaker: Isidore
segments.text: Workshop. We agreed to open the evening drop-in sessions from the sixth of November, provided that two volunteers sign up for each night.

segments.speaker: Calla
segments.text: I'll order the spare inner tubes from Kettering Cycles by Tuesday, but I won't pay the invoice until Magnus checks the stock count.

segments.speaker: Magnus
segments.text: Prices. A basic service is 25 pounds, or 15 pounds for members, and a full overhaul is 60 pounds, or 40 pounds for members.

segments.speaker: Bettina
segments.text: Stands: the repair stands arrived last week and the wall rack is already fitted.

segments.speaker: Isidore
segments.text: Does anyone want to look at selling helmets? That's a question for next month, not a task.

segments.speaker: Magnus
segments.text: I'll run the market pop-up on the 8th.

segments.speaker: Bettina
segments.text: Not the 8th, the 15th. The market organisers moved it.

segments.speaker: Magnus
segments.text: Fine, the 15th then.

segments.speaker: Bettina
segments.text: Workshop, last item. We decided not to sell second-hand bikes under the co-op name, and Tamar from the council told me the repair grant was approved.

segments.speaker: Zuzana
segments.text: Projects. We decided to deliver the Brightwell manual in German and Polish on the 4th of December, once the client sends the final diagrams.

segments.speaker: Ambrose
segments.text: I'll finish the Polish glossary by Wednesday, and I won't start the review until Lindiwe uploads the style guide.

segments.speaker: Lindiwe
segments.text: Rates. Translation is 14 cents a word, or 11 cents a word for repeat clients.

segments.speaker: Zuzana
segments.text: Cormac will upload the style guide by Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Cormac
segments.text: No, that's Lindiwe's file, so Lindiwe should upload it. I'll send Brightwell the revised quote by the 2nd of December, because the client asked for it in writing.

segments.speaker: Lindiwe
segments.text: Fine, I'll upload it by Tuesday. Should we look at a second translation tool? That's a question, not a task.

segments.speaker: Ambrose
segments.text: Quality: the Hartley translation memory was already migrated, and the legal review was approved last week.

segments.speaker: Zuzana
segments.text: Dalia at Brightwell told me the invoice has been paid in full.

segments.speaker: Cormac
segments.text: Projects, last item. We agreed not to take rush jobs at weekends, and I won't accept the Kestrel contract until Zuzana approves the rates.

segments.speaker: Octavia
segments.text: Schedule. We agreed to move the folk hour to the evening slot from the 3rd of May, sorry, I mean the 5th of May, as long as the studio is free.

segments.speaker: Jarek
segments.text: Fundraising: I'll email the local businesses about sponsorship by Friday, unless Octavia has written to them already.

segments.speaker: Dhruv
segments.text: Membership. Membership is 20 pounds a year, or 12 pounds for students and pensioners, and the station insurance costs 640 pounds.

segments.speaker: Leona
segments.text: Jingle: I'll record the new station jingle at the church hall on Saturday, only if the choir has at least 12 singers.

segments.speaker: Octavia
segments.text: Jarek told me the council approved our broadcast licence renewal.

segments.speaker: Dhruv
segments.text: I'll fix the transmitter aerial by the 30th unless it rains.

segments.speaker: Octavia
segments.text: Studio: the new mixing desk was delivered on Monday and the old desk is already sold.

segments.speaker: Leona
segments.text: Could we ask the library about a weekend slot? That's not a task, just an idea. We decided not to air the late-night phone-in this season, and I won't edit the jingle until Dhruv sends the final lyrics.

segments.speaker: Jarek
segments.text: The lottery grant application was approved last week, and the van is already back from the garage.
